teacher_info.teaching_style: My lessons are structured, but there is room for flexibility. Each student is different, so I adapt my lessons to the needs of the individual. I include a lot of humor in my lessons because I feel that is the best way to make students feel comfortable speaking English. Humor provides a positive experience, encouraging the student to continue learning. I am very patient and provide lots of encouragement. Homework and extra practice opportunities are always available to students who want more practice. I hope you will join me on your journey to learn English.

teacher_info.introduction: Welcome dear friends. My name is Ben. I have a BA degree in psychology and social behavior, MA in English Language Teaching, and a TEFL teaching certificate. I am a professional English teacher originally from Southern California and am currently residing in Northern California for the moment being. I'm eager to work with students of all levels (beginner, elementary, intermediate, upper-intermediate, advanced). I'm very patient, friendly (I like meeting new people), and eager to cooperate and teach students in a manner that is stress-free and encourages their language learning development. After having traveled abroad and living in a different country for 4 years I've came to realize that many people move to a new country completely unprepared and feel lost and worried. They do not have the survival English to find a job, call for an emergency, fill out a form, order food, find a special store, use a taxi, get directions or communicate efficiently at all . As a result, my lessons are heavily tailored to developing strong conversation or speaking skills (which develop all four skills speaking, listening, reading, writing) and also learning about the culture, thinking, and behavior of English speakers, and finally developing different lessons and materials based on whatever you need English for and in a manner where you will learn to become an independent English learner so you can feel as comfortable as a native English speaker without ever feeling like you're lost. Be patient and work hard with me and you'll learn how to survive and work with the English language, make good friends, enjoy the language and even use it to travel the world.

teacher_info.about_teacher: I have been working as a German and English tutor since 2012 and I first began while I was still working on my undergraduate programme. I have experience teaching German at all levels and English from Low Intermediate to Advanced, including general language acquisition, reading/writing skills for both native and non-native speakers, intensive grammar and exams.
teacher_info.teaching_style: I hope to help develop each student’s ability to explore German and English in both the context of an activity and the context of their own understanding of the language. My students and I explore the target language of a particular lesson in increasingly more detail together so that by the end of the lesson the student has a clearer understanding of the themes and vocabulary we have covered. My lessons tend to be structured, but I do adapt them, including review and supplementary material based on each of my student’s individual strengths and weaknesses. I most often use CEFR level-appropriate coursebooks, books specific to each student’s individual aims, and self-created materials.

pro_course_detail.title: General German for Beginners to Elementary (A1-A2)
pro_course_detail.description:
Would you like to build up a strong foundation in German? Do you already know some basic expressions or are you starting to learn the language from scratch? Then this course is for you!

We will use an A1 or A2 level book series to learn vocabulary, practise speaking on a variety of everyday topics, and ease into grammar. Whether you aim to spend some time in a German-speaking country, learn something new, or one day speak German to family, friends, and loved ones, we will work to develop your ability to express yourself and understand spoken and written German for use in everyday life. 

Students will be assigned light homework exercises to review vocabulary and structures covered in class before the next lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: Lesestunde: German Reading and Writing (B1-C2)
pro_course_detail.description:
In order to improve your reading and writing skills we will practise different reading techniques and strategies and look at writing as a process. During our German lessons we will read an interesting text - at times aloud, at times individually - before completing exercises that will help to strengthen your understanding of the text and expand your vocabulary. You will learn how to avoid writing mistakes and how to successfully structure and edit your own writing so that is easily readable. 
 
Our aim in this course is not to seek perfection or mistake-free German, but rather to strive towards an understandable use of the language in speech and writing and deepen your joy of reading.
 
Um Ihre Lese- und Schreibfertigkeiten zu verbessern werden wir zusammen unterschiedliche Lesetechniken und -strategien üben und das Schreiben als Prozess betrachten. Während der Deutschstunde lesen wir mal vor, mal als Einzelarbeit, und erledigen Aufgaben, die Ihr Verständnis des Textes verfestigen und ihren Wortschatz erweitern sollen. Sie werden lernen wie man Schreibfehler vermeiden kann und einen gut lesbaren Text erfolgreich aufbaut und bearbeitet. 
 
Wir streben nicht nach Perfektion oder fehlerfreiem Deutsch, sondern nach einer verständlichen Sprache in Wort und Schrift und mehr Freude am Lesen.

pro_course_detail.title: Book Club: Reading and Writing in English (B1-C2)
pro_course_detail.description:
In this course you will improve your use of English by reading, discussing, and writing about thought-provoking essays, interviews, articles, and stories of various lengths and types. We will practise reading aloud and individually during our English lessons, although at times you may be asked to read a chapter or medium-length short story at home to prepare for our discussion in the next lesson. We will look at different strategies for using a text to learn new vocabulary, complete comprehension exercises in order to strengthen your understanding of key ideas in the text, and learn to structure and edit your own stories, essays and written responses.
 
Our aim in this course is not to seek perfection or mistake-free English, but rather to strive towards an effective use of the language in speech and writing and deepen your joy of reading.

pro_course_detail.title: Exploring the Canon: A Light Reading of English Classics (B1-C2)
pro_course_detail.description:
If you’ve ever wanted to tackle Beowulf or a Shakespearean play in a stress-free, non-academic setting, this course is for you!

In this course we will read and discuss a handful of English-language texts that have served as the inspiration for art, poetry, drama, and film from their conception to the modern day. We will take a look at both historical and modern works, including plays, short stories, essays and longer works, some of which may be adapted for the modern reader. Although our discussions and activities will be loosely structured on key themes and elements of style in the texts, students are encouraged to bring their own discussion questions and ideas to class.

A modest, manageable amount of at-home reading may be assigned depending on the work we are covering. Students are advised to take their time with the material and wait to book the next lesson until they have completed the reading.

pro_course_detail.title: Individually Customised Lessons in German (A1-C2)
pro_course_detail.description:
This class option is ideal for German learners at all levels who are:

+ preparing for an upcoming unit test/quiz in your German class at a (language) school or university
+ at risk of failing a German class and need additional support
+ self-learners with various questions about the language and/or would like structured practice on a specific grammatical topic

We can schedule a specialised one-time session or package deal in order to clarify, review, and practise using the grammatical structures and vocabulary that you find difficult. If you would like regularly-scheduled, personally customised lessons for a reason other than those mentioned above, please send me a message about what you would like to focus on specifically and we can see about developing the proper course of action to realise your language learning goals.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational Speaking

pro_course_detail.title: Intensive English Grammar
pro_course_detail.description:
In this course you will learn about the rules of English grammar in speech and writing. You will learn how to structure simple and complex sentences, tell stories using the narrative tenses, effectively use modal verbs and improve your use of conditionals, continuous forms and prepositions. 

Students will be provided with digital learning materials for class and assigned homework exercises to review grammatical structures and concepts before the next lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational English (All Levels)
pro_course_detail.description:
My Conversational English lessons are designed to help students of all proficiency levels—from beginners to experts—develop their speaking skills in a supportive and engaging environment.

Core Activities: 
Role-Playing: Simulate real-life scenarios (e.g., ordering food, job interviews, travel).
Discussion Circles: Group discussions on selected topics (e.g., hobbies, cultural differences).
Debate Sessions: Structured debates on controversial issues (e.g., environmental policies).
Storytelling: Students create and share stories based on prompts, enhancing creativity and fluency.
Conversation Games: Interactive games (e.g., “20 Questions,” “Would You Rather?”) to build vocabulary and spontaneity.

Material and Resources:
Articles and Short Stories: Authentic reading materials to stimulate discussion.
Videos and Podcasts: Multimedia resources to expose students to various accents and conversational styles.
Real-life Objects and Pictures: Visual aids to spark conversations and build descriptive language skills.

Each lesson is tailored to the students’ levels and needs, ensuring a balance between structured activities and free-flowing conversation. The goal is to build confidence, improve fluency, and make learning English an enjoyable and rewarding experience. Through varied activities, authentic materials, and diverse topics, students will find themselves more comfortable and proficient in conversational English.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Studying Abroad
pro_course_detail.description:
The "English for Studying Abroad" course is designed to equip students with the language skills and cultural knowledge needed to succeed in an academic setting abroad. The course will cover a range of levels, from beginner to advanced, ensuring that all students receive tailored instruction to meet their specific needs.

Beginner Level:
-Vocabulary building: Common academic terms, classroom objects, basic phrases.
Simple conversations: Introducing oneself, asking for directions, basic classroom interactions.
-Reading and comprehension: Short texts related to student life, simple articles.
-Listening exercises: Understanding classroom instructions, short dialogues.

Intermediate Level:
-Expanded vocabulary: Subject-specific terminology, idiomatic expressions.
-Group discussions: Participating in study groups, sharing opinions on academic topics.
-Reading and writing: Summarizing articles, writing short essays.
-Listening and speaking: Note-taking from lectures, presenting ideas in class.

Advanced Level:
-Advanced vocabulary: Academic research terms, professional jargon.
-Debates and presentations: Arguing a point of view, delivering structured presentations.
-In-depth reading: Analyzing journal articles, critical thinking exercises.
-Writing: Crafting research papers, composing formal emails.

By the end of this course, students will feel confident and prepared to navigate the academic challenges and cultural differences they will encounter while studying abroad.

pro_course_detail.title: Supremo Latin American Spanish
pro_course_detail.description:
This is a unique opportunity for you since I am American and English is my first language. My Spanish is near-native. That means that I'm not just fluent in Spanish, but quite often I am mistaken for a native speaker and because of how well I speak and interact in Spanish many natives are surprised that I'm American. 

Since there are so many native Spanish speakers on italki, why take classes with me?  Sooner or later there will be some expressions, concepts or ideas that you will not be able to either understand or express. A native Spanish speaker won't necessarily be able to explain this and help you to clear up your confusion on the subject the way I can. Sometimes a hundred examples just doesn't help you to know how to say something. As a speaker of English I usually anticipate what my students are trying to say. My classes are extremely productive. 

I have been a translator and interpreter for over 20 years. I've lived in Spain, Colombia, Peru, Chile, Costa Rica and Panama.  So not only do I speak Spanish almost like a native, but I'm familiar with some of the accents and vocabulary differences that you might come across from country to country. 

It's a great language. It's fun to learn, but it does take work.  Why not try some classes with me. I know you'll enjoy them.

I prefer to speak Spanish in the class. I will slow it down if you need that. I will make sure you understand me and slowly increase the speed over time as your comprehension increases. If you insist I will be happy to speak some English in the class to guide you and explain some grammar rules if need be. 

I am a certified TEFL and TESOL language instructor and I use similar methods when I teach Spanish. I look forward to hearing from you.
